edit.statement: Lake Sarez in Tajikistan was formed in 1911 when the Usoi landslide, set off by an earthquake, dammed the Murghab River.
edit.subject: Lake Sarez
edit.object: the 1911 earthquake-triggered Usoi landslide that dammed the Murghab River

notes: Real: the 18 February 1911 Sarez earthquake triggered the Usoi rockslide, a natural dam about 600 m high that impounds the Murghab River (USGS, Usoi Landslide Dam and Lake Sarez; Wikipedia). Obscure outside geology and hazard literature.
